text.text_excerpt: Voodoo Vibe is a smaller venue to catch a band, but that's what I love about it. The band that was playing was really good. I never knew this place existed, but who can resist a good cover of the Violet Femmes? So the music hooked us and the staff was friendly less aggressive than other doormen/shot girls on Bourbon. It's a good place to chill and catch a good band based on all the reviews. The fact that it's a smaller venue works for this place, because it's a similar scene as Famous Door or BBC, but alot easier to take in.

Is there anything more depressing than elderly strippers? Before you answer, you should know that there isn't. And if you are unfortunate enough to mistakenly encounter women of grandparent age who are still removing their clothing for a living somewhere in the French Quarter, you're probably going to need a drink. You're in luck, because Voodoo Vibe has $3 shots. Shockingly, this promotion is not limited to the test tubes of juice that future elderly strippers try to shove down your throat everywhere on Bourbon Street, but it also extends to DON JULIO (and it seems, everything else). So yeah, we stayed for four shots each. Don't judge me. They were a bit watered down, as our overeager ba...

After a catered evening event at the Wax Museum, we headed out into a torrential downpour. After taking refuge at the Famous Door, we wanted to move on. The band was awesome so we ducked in out of the rain...no cover and we could bring in our drinks. We stayed a long time because the band was so good and have everyone up dancing. Even though we were soaked to the bone, we had a great time there and will hit this place up again on the next NOLA trip!
